name: sap-fiori-timesheet-mcp
description: Fill in and query SAP Fiori Standard & Multiproject timesheets (built for BearingPoint xflow) from Claude.
long_description:
A local MCP server that drives the SAP Fiori *Standard timesheet* and *Multiproject timesheet* apps. It signs in through Microsoft Entra ID SSO with a headless browser (the browser is downloaded once, ~150 MB, on the first login), caches the resulting SAP session cookies locally, and then talks to the SAP OData services directly for every read and write.

Use it to see which working days are still missing hours, look up chargeable sales orders / non-chargeable receiver orders / attendance types, book or delete time entries across a range of days, apply an MDS staffing plan, and allocate or re-balance hours across projects in the multiproject grid. Every writing tool supports a dry run. Nothing is sent anywhere except your own SAP system; credentials are never stored, only the session cookies.

launchpad_url.title: Fiori launchpad URL
launchpad_url.description: Full URL of your SAP Fiori launchpad. The SAP host is derived from it. Defaults to BearingPoint's xflow portal.

email.title: SSO email (optional)
email.description: Microsoft Entra ID account email. Set it here so the login_start tool can run without asking; leave blank to pass it at login time. Never stored.

password.title: SSO password (optional)
password.description: Password for the account above. Stored in the OS keychain by Claude Desktop, passed to the server only as an environment variable, and never written to disk by the server. Leave blank to type it at login time.

sap_client.title: SAP client (optional)
sap_client.description: The SAP client number (sap-client), e.g. 006, if your system needs one pinned.

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Whether an SAP session is available (renews it silently through the persistent browser profile when possible); returns the SAP user and whether the sign-in is remembered.

tools.name: sso_login
tools.description: Establish an SAP session through the persistent browser profile: cached, silent (no prompt) when the identity provider still remembers the browser, otherwise a sign-in window on the user's machine. Preferred over login_start.

tools.name: login_start
tools.description: Compatibility login with credentials (prefer sso_login): drives the Microsoft SSO form headlessly in the persistent profile. Returns done, otp_required, or number_match.

tools.name: login_submit_otp
tools.description: Provide the one-time verification code requested by login_start.

tools.name: login_wait
tools.description: Wait for the login to progress after a number_match step.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Delete the stored SAP session; with forgetIdentity also delete the browser profile that remembers the sign-in.

tools.name: std_info
tools.description: Standard timesheet profile: personnel number, data-entry profile, whether entries are released directly.

tools.name: std_days
tools.description: Every working day of the range with filled/missing state, target/booked/missing hours and entries.

tools.name: std_open_days
tools.description: Working days in open periods that still have missing hours, with the entries already booked on each.

tools.name: std_calendar
tools.description: Calendar days with target hours, working-day flag and period status.

tools.name: std_entries
tools.description: List time entries (counter, date, hours, status, item) in a date range.

tools.name: std_jobcodes
tools.description: Which jobcodes (orders, sales orders, attendance types) a range contains, with days, hours, dates and share.

tools.name: std_staffing
tools.description: The MDS staffing plan for the range (what the app's 'Retrieve staffing' button loads).

tools.name: std_staffing_apply
tools.description: Book the staffing plan on open days that still miss the planned hours; returns created + skipped.

tools.name: std_favorites
tools.description: List favorite entries (name, default hours, item).

tools.name: std_favorite_add
tools.description: Create a favorite.

tools.name: std_favorite_remove
tools.description: Delete a favorite by id.

tools.name: std_attendance_types
tools.description: Attendance / absence types (AWART codes).

tools.name: std_chargeable_orders
tools.description: Chargeable sales orders (RKDAUF) with client, partner and manager; resolves a numeric query by order code.

tools.name: std_non_chargeable_orders
tools.description: Non-chargeable receiver orders (RAUFNR).

tools.name: std_sales_order_items
tools.description: Items (RKDPOS) of a chargeable sales order.

tools.name: std_worklist
tools.description: Worklist (assigned orders) for a date range.

tools.name: std_fill
tools.description: Book the same item on several days (one entry per day). Give an item or a favorite.

tools.name: std_set
tools.description: Make the given days contain exactly one item: existing entries are deleted, then the item is booked.

tools.name: std_fill_open
tools.description: Book one item on every open day of the range, each with that day's missing hours (optionally capped).

tools.name: std_update
tools.description: Change the hours / item of an existing entry.

tools.name: std_remove
tools.description: Delete entries by counter (from std_entries / std_open_days).

tools.name: mp_months
tools.description: Multiproject timesheet: months with status (open / PER_CLOSED) and totals.

tools.name: mp_month
tools.description: Multiproject timesheet grid of a month: projects (columns) and days with hours per project.

tools.name: mp_favorites
tools.description: Favorites as listed by the multiproject app.

tools.name: mp_allocate
tools.description: Allocate hours per day to a project in the multiproject timesheet (creates the column; 0 clears a day).

tools.name: mp_allocate_many
tools.description: Allocate several projects in one save, each with explicit days and/or a working-day range at a per-day hours value.

tools.name: mp_stats
tools.description: Which projects a day / range / month contains in the multiproject timesheet, with hours, days and proportion.

tools.name: mp_balance
tools.description: Rewrite the working days of a range so the given projects hold the requested proportions of the target hours.

tools.name: mp_clear
tools.description: Remove a project's hours on the given days (all days of the month if omitted).
